hero.headline: ARKA JAIN University Online MBA in Human Resource Management: Syllabus, Fees and Career Outcomes
hero.sub: UGC-DEB approved 2-year programme | NAAC A accredited | Generative AI in Sem 1

sections.tldr: Generative AI for Online Learners is a mandatory Sem 1 subject. ARKA JAIN is a Jharkhand-based JGI Online institution, not JAIN Deemed University (Bengaluru).

about.body:
ARKA JAIN University's Online MBA in Human Resource Management covers the full HR lifecycle: talent acquisition, learning and development, industrial relations, performance management, compensation design, and organizational change.

IMPORTANT: ARKA JAIN University is a Jharkhand-based institution under the JGI Group, operating from Jamshedpur. It is NOT the same as JAIN Deemed-to-be University in Bengaluru. Different university, different management, different accreditation profile. ARKA JAIN is NAAC A, not ranked in NIRF 2025. Confirm you are applying to the correct institution before proceeding.

The Generative AI for Online Learners course in Semester 1 is a mandatory credit-bearing subject across all MBA specialisations. For HR professionals, this means applied skills in AI-assisted recruitment screening, automated report generation, and prompt engineering for HR analytics. This is built into the curriculum, not a marketing claim.

EdifyEdu verifies data independently and takes no commission from any university.

subjects.name: Organizational Behavior and Human Resources Management
Business Research Methods
subjects.description: Research design, data collection methods, sampling techniques, hypothesis testing, and research report writing for management.

subjects.name: Operations Management
subjects.description: Production planning, supply chain basics, quality management systems, inventory control, and process optimisation.

subjects.name: Talent Acquisition and Management
subjects.description: Recruitment strategy design, employer branding, candidate assessment frameworks, onboarding processes, and talent pipeline management.

subjects.name: Learning and Development
subjects.description: Training needs analysis, instructional design, e-learning strategy, competency mapping, and ROI measurement for L&D programmes.

subjects.name: Industrial Relations and Labor Laws
subjects.description: Trade union management, collective bargaining, Industrial Disputes Act, Factories Act, new Labour Codes, and workplace compliance.

subjects.name: Employee Management and Negotiation Skills
subjects.description: Conflict resolution, grievance handling, negotiation strategies, employee engagement frameworks, and workplace communication.

subjects.name: Open Elective Course
subjects.description: Elective chosen from outside the HRM specialisation. Provides cross-functional exposure in finance, marketing, or general management.

subjects.name: Strategic Management
subjects.description: Competitive strategy frameworks, corporate-level strategy, strategic analysis tools (SWOT, Porter's Five Forces), and strategic implementation.

subjects.name: International Human Resource Management
subjects.description: Cross-cultural management, expatriate policies, global mobility, international labour standards, and multinational HR strategy.

subjects.name: Performance Management Systems
subjects.description: KPI design, balanced scorecard, 360-degree feedback, OKR frameworks, performance appraisal methods, and linking performance to rewards.

subjects.name: Organization Development and Change Management
subjects.description: OD interventions, change readiness assessment, Kotter's model, resistance management, and culture transformation planning.

subjects.name: Employee Compensation and Benefits Management
subjects.description: Salary structuring, CTC components, variable pay design, ESOP frameworks, statutory benefits, and total rewards strategy.

subjects.name: Master Thesis / Project
subjects.description: Supervised research project on an HR management topic. Literature review, methodology design, data analysis, and thesis presentation.

whoHires.body:
**Industries:** IT/ITES, manufacturing, BFSI, healthcare, retail, e-commerce, consulting, and government/PSU HR departments

**Entry-level roles:** HR Executive, Talent Acquisition Specialist, L&D Coordinator, Payroll Analyst, Employee Engagement Associate

**Mid-level roles:** HR Manager, Talent Acquisition Manager, L&D Manager, Compensation and Benefits Manager, HR Business Partner

**Senior roles:** Head of HR, CHRO (mid-market), VP People Operations, Director of Talent, Head of Organizational Development

**Regional note:** ARKA JAIN's JGI Group network provides stronger placement access in East India (Jharkhand, Bihar, Odisha, West Bengal). Manufacturing and mining sector HR roles are particularly relevant in the Jamshedpur industrial corridor. Candidates targeting metro markets should supplement with independent networking.

**How to check placement claims:** ask ARKA JAIN University - JGI Online (arkajain.edu.in) Online for its latest placement report in writing, for your programme and mode. Online batches are often reported apart from campus ones, or not at all. edifyedu.in does not publish employer lists it cannot source. Treat the roles above as the kinds of jobs this syllabus prepares you for, not as a list of who has hired from this batch.

skills.body:
The HRM specialisation builds skills across talent management, labour compliance, and organizational development:

- Talent Acquisition: recruitment strategy design, employer branding, candidate assessment, ATS management, and onboarding process design
- Compensation Design: CTC structuring, variable pay models, ESOP frameworks, statutory benefits calculation, and total rewards benchmarking
- Labour Law Compliance: Industrial Disputes Act, Factories Act, new Labour Codes (2020), PF/ESI compliance, and workplace safety norms
- Performance Management: KPI/OKR design, balanced scorecard implementation, 360-degree feedback setup, and appraisal calibration

- Organizational Development: change readiness assessment, culture audit, OD intervention design, and transformation project management
- International HRM: expatriate policy design, cross-cultural team management, global mobility processes, and international labour standards

**AI skills:** Prompt engineering for HR analytics, AI-assisted screening tools, automated report generation, and GenAI for employee communication drafts.

fees.body: EdifyEdu rechecks fees with ARKA JAIN every quarter. Please check with our counsellor before you pay. Fees listed are indicative.

certificate.body:
Graduates receive an MBA degree certificate with Human Resource Management as the specialisation, issued by ARKA JAIN University under UGC-DEB 2020 online mode standards.

The degree carries NAAC A accreditation and UGC-DEB approval. Valid for government recruitment, PSU HR roles, corporate HR positions, and higher education admissions. The certificate reads Master of Business Administration without the word 'online' on the document face, consistent with UGC-DEB norms. DigiLocker integration available for digital verification.

faqs.question: Is ARKA JAIN different from JAIN Deemed University?
faqs.answer: Yes. ARKA JAIN University is a separate Jharkhand-based institution in Jamshedpur, operated under the JGI Group. Confirm you are applying to the correct institution before making any payment.

faqs.question: What is the Generative AI subject in Sem 1?
faqs.answer: Generative AI for Online Learners is a mandatory credit-bearing subject in Semester 1 across all ARKA JAIN MBA specialisations. For HRM students, this translates to applied skills in AI-assisted recruitment screening, automated HR reporting, prompt engineering for employee communications, and GenAI tools for HR analytics. This is built into the curriculum from the ground up, not a workshop or add-on.

faqs.question: Does the HRM specialisation cover Indian labour laws?
faqs.answer: Yes. Industrial Relations and Labor Laws is a standalone Semester 3 subject covering the Industrial Disputes Act, Factories Act, new Labour Codes (2020), trade union management, collective bargaining, PF/ESI compliance, and workplace safety norms. This is particularly relevant for HR professionals in manufacturing, mining, and industrial sectors.

faqs.question: What HR roles can I target after this MBA?
faqs.answer: Entry-level roles include HR Executive, Talent Acquisition Specialist, and L&D Coordinator. Mid-level targets include HR Manager, HR Business Partner, and Compensation Manager. Senior roles include Head of HR and CHRO (mid-market companies). The JGI Group network provides stronger access to East India employers.
